records.ownerInstruction: Make the active watch source point to OpenAI's crawler documentation; keep the old link as historical evidence and review the Atlas-dependent advice before representing it as current.
records.reviewGate: Verify the new URL resolves to OAI-SearchBot/GPTBot/ChatGPT-User/OAI-AdsBot definitions; flag old Atlas/Apps claims as due for re-review rather than quietly transferring them.
records.stopCondition: Do not bulk-replace the old URL under referral or Atlas statements with crawler docs that cannot substantiate them.

records.ownerInstruction: Select a small sample of the highest-seen Goose advice and target-site pages. Require one distinct useful action, owner-valid example, evidence boundary, reason not to use it and concise human explanation. Record real defects and corrections.
records.reviewGate: Review original vs updated pages with user, specialist, editor and skeptic roles. Check no invented first-hand experience or claims, and preserve non-changes.
records.stopCondition: Do not equate lower AI-text scores or higher keyword density with search improvement.

records.ownerInstruction: Add a bounded metadata-to-visible-facts editorial comparison to the current publication review for pages revised with AI assistance; include title, meta description, alt, JSON-LD claims and canonical job.
records.reviewGate: On sampled built pages, reject invented product availability, author, review, results or attributes. Compare against the visible source of truth.
records.stopCondition: Do not auto-generate alternate metadata from unverified page summaries.

records.ownerInstruction: On one existing canonical resource, add a small real repeatable experiment: question, baseline, original sample, exact method, observation, negative cases and a practical decision. Review permissions before exposing data.
records.reviewGate: Verify source and final deployment refs, copyright/consent, reproducer and an independently understandable result; keep failures.
records.stopCondition: Never manufacture survey respondents, third-party endorsements or a fabricated AI-citation gain.

records.ownerInstruction: If the owner has Bing access, import a bounded query-page pair set, map stable page IDs, note provider scope and keep a review queue for mismatched intent or repeated citations.
records.reviewGate: Compare raw pair mapping to cited page state and visible factual support; preserve nonreturned queries and sampling limits.
records.stopCondition: Do not claim any specific prompt, model answer, ranking or causality from aggregated grounding labels.

records.ownerInstruction: For sites wanting ChatGPT discovery, reconcile publisher choice per bot with robots.txt, real WAF/CDN settings and independently observed requests from documented IP ranges; keep search/training/ads/user actions distinct.
records.reviewGate: Check verified bot IPs, allowed public routes, HTTP/noindex, challenge/403 and intentionally protected paths. Use limited non-spoofed evidence.
records.stopCondition: Do not disable firewalls wholesale, turn on training to gain search visibility or assume user-triggered ChatGPT-User is Search indexing.

records.ownerInstruction: On one active owned site with enough cited pages, group the actual provider intent labels; select one page whose published content can genuinely answer a different stage or task without creating an extra URL.
records.reviewGate: Review mislabeled/ambiguous intent manually; inspect page usefulness and any later cited page/query pairs.
records.stopCondition: Skip when no Bing owner observations exist; preview labels are not reliable for every niche.

records.ownerInstruction: Map provider topic labels to existing canonical resource pages and authentic subject boundaries. Improve an existing information gap before considering a new page.
records.reviewGate: Check manually that provider topics are coherent; retain ambiguous/mixed labels and do not change frozen query experiments retroactively.
records.stopCondition: Do not mass-generate one page per topic or mistake provider topic classifications for ranking authority.

records.ownerInstruction: Freeze up to 10 owner-observed relevant grounding queries and compare their Bing-native Citation Share at comparable intervals alongside raw citation counts and page IDs.
records.reviewGate: Verify query-scoped denominator, preview availability, dates and changes in the observed query mix.
records.stopCondition: Don't rank unrelated queries, providers or businesses by a blended citation percentage.

records.ownerInstruction: Record a frozen current/previous window, actual cited pages and exposure context. Include zero, flat and negative examples and known releases/outages.
records.reviewGate: Check consistent page/query scope and finality/lag; preserve provider sampling warnings.
records.stopCondition: Don't use a prior period with different eligibility or a changed query set as a causal control.

records.ownerInstruction: Check owner-side generative report availability and reporting dimensions separately. Keep missing as unavailable; preserve scope, date/time zone and provider semantics.
records.reviewGate: Re-run the existing Google import on an actual supplied report only; verify API/CSV columns before labeling impressions.
records.stopCondition: Do not infer a ChatGPT/Bing referral or a specific AI answer from Google's impressions.

records.ownerInstruction: For sites actually behind Cloudflare, compare intended role policy with the account's effective crawler settings and WAF rules; record host/path and customer choice.
records.reviewGate: Inspect live settings and verified response logs before changing a rule, especially ad-serving pages and multi-purpose bots.
records.stopCondition: Do not recommend unblocking all AI bots or altering a site that is not on Cloudflare.

records.ownerInstruction: Compare the real top crawler-request URL families, response status/bytes, and AI-origin referral landing sections with the site's actual task priority.
records.reviewGate: Verify provider read permissions, bot-role labels, stable periods and sample disclosure; do not infer unique users from requests.
records.stopCondition: Do not use aggregate request volume as an authority score or scrape privacy-protected logs.

records.ownerInstruction: If publisher/consumer policies require it, run a tiny authorized crawl with contentUse=reference and, where policy allows, contentUse=full; verify allowed/rejected requests and the effective directive.
records.reviewGate: Check the robots content-use directive, resulting status and source permission before/after, without bypassing policy.
records.stopCondition: Never present Cloudflare's use directive as an IETF final standard or universal Google policy.

records.ownerInstruction: Keep a version-pinned compatibility matrix for Content-Usage HTTP/robots signals and the precise draft revision; only prototype on a test site when the real publisher rights decision exists.
records.reviewGate: Check the current IETF working-group revision and consumer support; ensure no contradiction with existing robots, contracts or actual licensing.
records.stopCondition: Do not automatically emit draft fields across all target sites or confuse rights preferences with guaranteed enforcement.

records.ownerInstruction: On a genuinely published video, align VideoObject creator/author with the public brand/person credited on the watch page and actual media rights; no source changes for pages without a video.
records.reviewGate: Rich Results Test, visible credit, canonical video/watch URL and playable media inspection.
records.stopCondition: Skip for text-only guides, fictional brands, unverified authorship or unreleased videos.

records.ownerInstruction: Only publish InteractionCounter data backed by the video host's actual metric and supported interaction type; otherwise omit it.
records.reviewGate: Validate the interaction type, actual counts and disclosure of their scope, then compare visible facts.
records.stopCondition: Never synthesize engagement from page views or a text reader count.

records.ownerInstruction: For one real published lesson/demo with clear segments, publish accurate key-moment labels/timestamps and working deep links; retain readable text/context.
records.reviewGate: Play each segment URL on mobile, keyboard and browser; validate Clip/SeekToAction and indexable watch page.
records.stopCondition: Do not add chapters to static images, nonexistent training videos or inaccessible recordings.

records.ownerInstruction: On a page whose visual genuinely explains the task, use a meaningful high-quality image with accessible alt, image URL, correct rights and consistent og:image/structured data. Make sure the preview works at different crops.
records.reviewGate: Inspect image fetch, actual dimensions, rights, rendered HTML, max-image-preview policy and mobile crop.
records.stopCondition: No decorative logos as giant Discover hero art and no promise of Discover placement.

records.ownerInstruction: For actual owned publishing channels, verify property access and inspect platform content discoverability; connect reports by canonical public topic only when evidence supports it.
records.reviewGate: Record provider/property scopes, canonical URLs and distinct date windows before cross-channel interpretation.
records.stopCondition: Do not add social accounts just to fill a dashboard or double count site and platform impressions.

records.ownerInstruction: For a project with an actually claimed Search profile and useful cross-platform content, add an accessible, correctly attributed optional link or official badge near the real publisher identity.
records.reviewGate: Verify the claimed profile resolves, correct brand attribution, accessible touch target and no unintended disclosure of a personal maintainer.
records.stopCondition: Skip unclaimed profiles, private creator identities and sites without a real follow use case.

records.ownerInstruction: Check an actual owned domain in the source preferences tool first; where available and editorially useful, trial one localized interactive button or text deep link on an article hub.
records.reviewGate: Verify eligibility of the exact domain, user-initiated flow, return navigation, mobile accessibility, and no false implication that the site is already preferred.
records.stopCondition: Do not show an inert button on the Goose GitHub Pages subdirectory or guarantee AI inclusion.

records.ownerInstruction: Only for a real travel/product/local-business aggregator serving EEA customers, review eligibility and the direct provider application path. Keep this as a conditional business opportunity in Goose.
records.reviewGate: Verify entity type, EEA consumer context, provider approval, available feed data and evidence of actual search unit appearance.
records.stopCondition: Not applicable to a general knowledge blog, Ptichi, or Vedokrok merely because it has many pages.

records.ownerInstruction: For real EEA direct hotel, flight, transport, local-service or merchant clients, separate supplier facts from aggregator feeds; review availability, actual service areas and source ownership.
records.reviewGate: Verify geography, business type, directly accessible data and supplier-unit presence if reported.
records.stopCondition: Don't confuse a local-direct supplier with a Vertical Search Service or create an empty feed for irrelevant sites.

records.ownerInstruction: Add a yes/no eligibility decision when Goose reviews an actual large forum/social platform; only eligible applicants should pursue OAuth/JSON-LD and minute-level updates.
records.reviewGate: Review independent user authorship, public stable URLs, moderation, user volume, engagement counter freshness and acceptance status.
records.stopCondition: Do not advise standard blogs or authored content sites to use it; it is not the general Indexing API.

records.ownerInstruction: For an actual eligible e-commerce owner, review merchant approval, access, canonical product identity and update cadence before building an export.
records.reviewGate: Check live scheme eligibility, authorization, publicly accessible real product/image URLs and accuracy of price/availability.
records.stopCondition: Do not build ACP feeds for non-commerce websites or present partner onboarding as generally open.

records.ownerInstruction: For an approved partner, validate stable item_id, brand, seller, title, description, canonical URL, image, stock and money, with distinct variants and stable parent/offer identity.
records.reviewGate: Compare each feed row to real public product and stock truth, schema required-field checks and production Stable version; never reuse IDs.
records.stopCondition: Do not ship the draft schema into production or invent GTIN, reviews, seller and availability.

records.ownerInstruction: For supported partner integrations, use a stable complete catalog plus permitted incremental upserts, keeping promotion feeds and timestamps in their documented channel.
records.reviewGate: Detect stale prices/availability by comparison with canonical commerce backend; run rollback and idempotency tests.
records.stopCondition: Skip if no authorized commerce backend or the partner has not been granted the required API/feed access.

records.ownerInstruction: On a retailer deliberately running ChatGPT ads, verify the ads-specific schema and crawlable landing pages with OAI-AdsBot and separate paid-vs-organic reporting.
records.reviewGate: Inspect live landing path, verified bot accessibility, forbidden categories and accurate advertising disclosures.
records.stopCondition: Do not treat ads feed upload as organic ChatGPT inclusion or confuse OAI-AdsBot with GPTBot.

records.ownerInstruction: For an actual merchant, align feed, public listing and structured Product/Offer category, currency and sale start/end timestamps from one authoritative commerce backend.
records.reviewGate: Rich Results Test, feed checks, time boundary tests and price parity after the promotion expires.
records.stopCondition: Skip if the site has no authentic offers, prices or eligible Product pages.

records.ownerInstruction: Choose one actual low-risk form flow whose native labels, validation and keyboard behavior are already good; trial WebMCP as an enhancement behind a browser support gate.
records.reviewGate: Compare real task completion with and without the trial; do not expose hidden server actions or confuse tool discovery with consent.
records.stopCondition: No fake web tools for actions that do not exist; retain ordinary HTML fallback and permission boundaries.

records.ownerInstruction: For a genuine opt-in agent workflow, freeze 5 representative tasks and 5 adversarial cases: injection, scope, duplicate call, rollback/confirmation, and denied access. Include no-WebMCP fallback.
records.reviewGate: Inspect DevTools schemas, per-task receipts, user confirmation and the absence of surprise mutations or data leaks.
records.stopCondition: Do not claim an origin-trial tool improves AI Search visibility or permit writes merely because a model requested them.

records.ownerInstruction: Where the owner already authorizes Cloudflare Browser Run, test a small unchanged-page snapshot vs a changed-page snapshot, with explicit max pages and content-use mode.
records.reviewGate: Confirm robots/Content Signals consent, bounded URL inclusion, matched bytes, retry handling and no forced full crawl.
records.stopCondition: Don't substitute crawler output for Google indexing or introduce paid crawling into no-budget projects.

records.ownerInstruction: Enhance the existing Trend Radar source review process with a redirect-topic/manual confirmation step, keeping exact URL, observed destination, source class and revision date.
records.reviewGate: Assert no automatic WATCH-to-ADOPT promotion; produce a review-required alert with before/after source role rather than replacing every source string automatically.
records.stopCondition: Don't infer a recommendation is false merely because a URL moved; reverify the specific mechanism at an appropriate primary replacement source.
